2609.39938.title: LEAP: Learned Block-wise Evidence Retrieval for Long Audio-Video Perception
2609.39938.paper_summary: Hour-scale audio-visual question answering is constrained by a context dilemma: dense whole-recording encoding rapidly exhausts context limits, whereas uniform temporal compression severely dilutes fine-grained acoustic and visual evidence. We introduce LEAP, a framework where the model retrieves its own evidence without placing the whole recording in one context. LEAP divides a recording into fixed-duration blocks, applying a lightweight localization pass to each block to score short candidate windows. The highest-ranked windows are pooled and re-encoded in a single bounded answer pass. Consequently, the answer input and peak context remain independent of the recording duration. By decoupling evidence localization from reasoning, our framework can localize candidate temporal windows over pre-computed transcripts without decoding media frames, while preserving fine-grained visual and non-speech evidence by routing the final answering pass over raw audio-visual streams. LEAP trains both stages: a localization LoRA improves the selected windows, and an answer LoRA improves the answers read from the same windows. The block grid natively supports causal queries, enabling LEAP to support streaming inference without streaming-specific training. Across several AVQA benchmarks, LEAP improves over the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B baseline by 4.5-16.8%, and transfers to a second omni-modal backbone, MiniCPM-o 4.5, surpassing its published results by 3.1-13.0%.
2609.39938.paper_summary_zh: 小時尺度的音視覺問題回答受到上下文困境的限制：密集的整體錄音編碼迅速耗盡上下文限制，而均勻的時間壓縮則嚴重稀釋了細緻的聲學和視覺證據。我們介紹了LEAP，一個框架，模型在不將整個錄音放入一個上下文中的情況下檢索自己的證據。LEAP將錄音劃分為固定時長的區塊，對每個區塊應用輕量級的定位過程來評分短候選窗口。排名最高的窗口被匯總並在單一的有界回答過程中重新編碼。因此，回答輸入和峰值上下文不受錄音時長的影響。通過將證據定位與推理解耦，我們的框架可以在不解碼媒體幀的情況下，根據預先計算的轉錄文本定位候選時間窗口，同時通過在原始音視覺流上路由最終回答過程來保留細緻的視覺和非語音證據。LEAP訓練兩個階段：定位LoRA改善所選窗口，而回答LoRA改善從相同窗口讀取的答案。區塊網格本質上支持因果查詢，使LEAP能夠支持流式推理而無需特定於流式的訓練。在幾個AVQA基準中，LEAP在Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B基準上提高了4.5-16.8%，並轉移到第二個全模態骨幹MiniCPM-o 4.5，超過其已發表的結果3.1-13.0%。
